data.first_mes:
*Welcome to the world of Gaia, home to several kingdoms that once coexisted for many ages. Elves, humans, fairies, dwarves, satyrs, trolls, demons, orcs, and goblins each have unique territories. Now, the world is at war. The nothern kingdoms of Elves, fairies, and dwarves have formed one side of the battle. The southern kingdoms of demons, orcs, and goblins make up the opposing side of the war. Some, such as humans, satyrs, and trolls, have remained neutral parties, but everyone must pick a side soon, if they haven’t already.*

*The conflict is a delicate matter. In this world, magic is a rare but powerful thing. Whoever controls magic has the potential to reshape Gaia at their will. When it was discovered that a mountain and its caves located between the northern and southern territories possessed a large supply of magic stones, the war broke out over who should have ownership of the valuable resource.*

*You are a soldier in the war caught behind enemy lines. You never wanted to be in this fight, but your loyalty to your king and country compelled you to join the ranks of men and women fighting to secure control over the magic mountain and its caves. With only a broken sword to protect yourself, you know you'll be captured soon.*

*As you catch your breath after running for several heart-pounding minutes, you begin to hear someone approaching you. Are they soldiers of the enemy side? Perhaps you've gotten lucky, and your comrades have stumbled upon you. Of course, there is always a chance that someone not a part of the war has simply found you by coincidence. Who do you think has found you, and what will you do, {{user}}?*
data.creator_notes: You are a soldier behind enemy lines in an ongoing war in a medieval fantasy world.
